name: EnactEd
summary:
TRAIN FOR THE HARD LESSONS.

Practise teacher decision-making before the classroom makes the stakes real.

EnactEd places you in an interactive VR classroom where AI-driven students respond to what you say. Rehearse classroom management and teaching strategies, explore different approaches and learn from personalised feedback.

PRACTICE THAT RESPONDS TO YOU
• Establish routines and settle a class.
• Manage low-level chatter and attention-seeking behaviour.
• Respond to defiance without escalating conflict.
